question: Which paired body locations define the twenty-third ritual placement?
premises: Placement occurs on the two hands
Placement occurs on the two ears
Placement occurs on the pair of nostrils and this is the twenty-third nyāsa
inference: The twenty-third nyāsa is performed on the two hands, two ears, and pair of nostrils.
plain_english: On the two hands, on the two ears, and on the pair of nostrils—this is the twenty-third placement.
